title: Missile fields as the obvious place for the watchers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Missile fields as the obvious place for the watchers, about post-1945; 1977 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Missile fields of South Dakota and Montana, USA

tellings.quote: then missile fields in South Dakota in Montana are not a strange place to find them at all. They are the obvious place.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels argues that if non-human visitors have been watching humanity since the start of the nuclear age in 1945, then the nuclear missile fields of South Dakota and Montana would not be a strange place to find them. He calls them "the obvious place." If he is right, it would mean these visitors take a special interest in our nuclear weapons.
